dsDescriptionValue.value: This datasets contains information on 856 Almanacs in the period of 1570 until 1705. Almanacs were published in Dutch language within the borders of contemporary Netherlands. All kinds of almanacs are described, year almanacs, continuous almanacs and everlasting almanacs. Bibliographic information on the almanacs, and information on publishers, authors and editors of almanacs is included.
